kpis.question: How many deterministic product-canon contradictions does the canon checker currently report?

kpis.question: How many capability-drift findings are currently open?

kpis.question: How many active routing references point at historical/frozen skill surfaces as authority?

kpis.question: How many closed issues are still presented as active execution authority in active ops surfaces?

kpis.source: gh issue view + ops docs scan

kpis.question: How many durable status docs claim active truth that contradicts live GitHub/repo state?

kpis.update_method: on-demand; UNKNOWN if gh unavailable or not collected

kpis.question: How many local worktrees/branches remain UNKNOWN/HOLD in a hygiene inventory?

kpis.source: git worktree list / git branch + repository-auditor procedure
kpis.window: local machine inventory at run time
kpis.update_method: on-demand local; never commit machine paths
limitations: Machine-local; snapshot reports UNKNOWN unless an inventory file is explicitly provided
kpis.privacy_boundary: sanitize paths; never commit absolute local paths

kpis.question: How many historical evidence docs lack an explicit historical/status marker?

kpis.question: How many repair commits occur per merged PR after first integration attempt?

kpis.question: How often do required checks fail then pass on later heads for the same PR?
kpis.definition: Count fail->success transitions of required contexts across PR heads

kpis.question: What share of PRs merge with zero repair commits and green required checks on the first evaluated head?
